statement: ∀ (ℓ r n : ℕ), ℓ.Prime → let B := (Finset.range ℓ).filter (fun v => v=0 ∨ (r*v)%ℓ = n%ℓ); B.card = (if ℓ∣r then (if ℓ∣n then ℓ else 1) else (if ℓ∣n then 1 else 2))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖第三批 · FR-9021 · 计算交换变量后 v(n−rv) 在素模中的局部根数
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage III · FR-9021 · Count the local roots of v(n−rv) after the semiprime switch

brief.zh: 分别处理 ℓ 整除 r、ℓ 整除 n 及两个根重合的情形。用模逆元给出 r 可逆时的根。对真实素数和需另保留 v=ℓ 或 n−rv=ℓ 的例外。
brief.en: Distinguish the cases where ℓ divides r, where ℓ divides n and where the roots coincide. Use the inverse of r when it is a unit. A sieve for the actual prime sum must retain the cases v=ℓ and n−rv=ℓ.
